app_description.message: Save what matters. Recall it later.

command_save_selection_with_note.message: Save selected text with a note

error_open_account.message: Could not open the account page

selection_toolbar_saved_hint_generic.message: Try recalling with any word you remember

selection_toolbar_try_recall_aria_generi.message: Try recalling with any word you remember

selection_toolbar_open_recall_failed.message: Could not open recall. Click the Yiveno icon.

selection_toolbar_note_placeholder.message: Add a note to find it later…

popup_import_failed_fallback.message: Bookmark import failed. Reload the extension and try again.

popup_welcome_title.message: What do you want to recall?

popup_welcome_body.message: Use a clue you remember to find what you saved—a site, an excerpt, or a note.

popup_clue_placeholder.message: e.g. that article about AI agents and memory from last week

popup_need_a_clue_body.message: These might be related, but none is strong enough yet. Refine the clue above, or say none of these.

popup_outcome_exit_prompt.message: Did you find what you were looking for?

popup_reply_confident.message: This is the most likely match.

popup_reply_uncertain.message: These might be related, but none is strong enough yet. Add a word that distinguishes them, or say none of these.

popup_reply_miss.message: Nothing in your library matches this clue. Misremembering or never saving it is a valid answer. Save a trace first if you want to find it later.

popup_session_status_continuing.message: Still refining this find — not a new one.

popup_reply_after_dismiss.message: Okay, let's try a different angle. Add the site, a quote, or something you wrote.

popup_followup_miss_constrained_empty.message: Nothing in your library matches that time and type. If the day might be wrong, try another time.

popup_followup_miss_constrained_empty_wi.message: Nothing in your library matches that time and type. If you might have the day wrong, here’s your most recent similar save — a guess, not the answer.

settings_subtitle.message: Manage recall preferences. Capabilities that are not live will not pretend to be.

settings_placeholder_privacy.message: Privacy options are not available yet. This page will not pretend they are.

settings_data_intro.message: Full backup export, clear local memory, or delete cloud data and your account. Export includes your full library state. Never changes Chrome bookmarks.

settings_data_clear_local_hint.message: Permanently delete local memories for this identity. Chrome bookmarks unchanged.

settings_data_clear_local_confirm.message: This permanently clears Yiveno local memory and will not change Chrome bookmarks. Bookmark ingest will turn off; if sync is on it will turn off too. Export first if you need a backup. Continue?

settings_data_clear_local_done_sync_off.message: Cleared $COUNT$ local memories; sync and bookmark ingest are off (Chrome bookmarks unchanged)

settings_privacy_intro.message: How Yiveno handles your memories, ownership, optional sync, and AI.

settings_privacy_details_summary.message: What Yiveno stores, who owns it, and what we send

settings_privacy_bullet_local.message: On device: excerpts, notes, bookmark traces, open/dismiss signals, and per-item recall helpers (tags, embeddings) in IndexedDB.

settings_privacy_bullet_ownership.message: You own what you Capture and your in-library usage history; per-item recall helpers stay with your items, not as separate Yiveno assets.

settings_privacy_bullet_export.message: Full backup export (Data section) is always available — a product responsibility, not a paid feature.

settings_privacy_bullet_cloud.message: Cloud (optional): uploaded only after you turn sync on.

settings_privacy_bullet_account.message: Account: sign-in for identity and optional sync.

settings_privacy_bullet_ai.message: AI: clue understanding may call a model; your full library is not sent by default.

settings_privacy_bullet_not_collected.message: Not collected: browsing history, clipboard reads, pages you did not capture, or de-identified aggregate product analytics as your personal export.

settings_privacy_ack_done.message: Your confirmation was saved. You can turn on cloud sync.

settings_privacy_ack_status_needed.message: Current notice version: not confirmed yet (required before turning sync on)

settings_privacy_sync_confirm.message: Turning on cloud sync aligns this device with the cloud (and may upload). Confirm you have read the privacy notice in Settings. Continue?

settings_privacy_open_policy_hint.message: Full notice on the Yiveno website.

settings_privacy_export_hint.message: Download all local memories as JSON — content, usage signals, and per-item recall helpers.

settings_privacy_delete_cloud_hint.message: Deletes cloud memories and backups. Local data stays; sync turns off.

settings_privacy_delete_cloud_confirm.message: This permanently deletes cloud memories and backups (not recoverable from backup). Local data stays by default. Continue?

settings_privacy_delete_cloud_done.message: Deleted $COUNT$ cloud item(s) and turned sync off

settings_privacy_delete_cloud_sign_in.message: Sign in to delete cloud memories or your account.

settings_privacy_delete_account_hint.message: Closes account and deletes cloud and local memories for this identity.

settings_privacy_delete_account_confirm.message: This permanently deletes your account (cloud memories, login identity, and this account’s local memories). It cannot be undone. To sign out only, use Account & Sync. Continue?

settings_privacy_delete_account_done.message: Account deleted ($CLOUD$ cloud item(s); cleared $LOCAL$ local item(s))

settings_error_privacy_notice_required.message: Confirm the privacy notice before turning on cloud sync

settings_error_privacy_ack.message: Could not save the privacy notice confirmation

settings_placeholder_ai.message: AI options are not available yet. This page will not pretend they are.

settings_ai_intro.message: Helps understand clues and enrich fields. MemoryItems remain the source of truth.

settings_ai_toggle_hint.message: Off: rules-only clue understanding; no Capture enrichment calls.

settings_ai_bullet_clue.message: Clue understanding: signed-in calls go through a Cloudflare Worker; quota exhaustion or failures fall back to rules.

settings_ai_bullet_enrichment.message: Capture enrichment: sparse async requests; proposals are validated before writing; never overwrites your note.

settings_ai_bullet_boundary.message: Boundary: we do not send your entire library to a model by default; models must not directly read/write the memory store.

settings_section_capture_copy.message: Control the selection save chip and Chrome bookmark ingest.

settings_toggle_selection_toolbar_hint.message: Shows “Save to Yiveno” after you select text

settings_toggle_chrome_bookmark_ingest_h.message: When off, stops import and live updates; keeps existing memories.

settings_section_shortcuts_copy.message: Review bindings here; change keys in Chrome.

settings_shortcuts_open_hint.message: Opens Chrome’s extension shortcuts page for Yiveno.

settings_section_account_copy.message: Sign in on the Yiveno website. The extension only syncs your login — it does not upload memories until you turn sync on.

settings_account_waiting_website.message: Finish signing in in the browser tab, then return here.

settings_sign_out_dialog_copy.message: By default, this account’s memories stay on this device after sign-out; Recall won’t show them while signed out. Confirm cloud backup before clearing the device copy.

settings_sign_out_dialog_counts.message: This account on device: $ACCOUNT$. Unmerged local profile: $LOCAL$. Cloud: $REMOTE$.

settings_sign_out_keep_local_hint.message: Keep this account’s data on this device (recommended)

settings_sign_out_clear_local.message: Sign out and clear this account on device

settings_sign_out_clear_local_hint.message: Cannot recover if never synced; does not delete pre-login local profile data

settings_sign_out_sync_then_clear.message: Sync to cloud, then sign out and clear device

settings_sign_out_sync_then_clear_hint.message: Replace cloud with this device (including local profile), then clear device; stays signed in if sync fails

settings_sign_out_sync_then_clear_disabl.message: No account/local-profile data on device to upload

settings_section_sync_copy.message: Off by default. When on, merges this device with the cloud, then syncs about every 15 minutes.

settings_sync_toggle_hint.message: Sign in from the header account icon first.

settings_sync_sign_in_required.message: Sign in first to manage sync.

settings_error_auth_not_configured.message: Sign-in is not configured in this build

settings_error_sync_pro_required.message: Cloud sync requires an active Pro subscription

settings_error_sync_replace_local.message: Could not replace cloud with this device

settings_error_sync_replace_local_empty.message: This device has no memories; cannot overwrite the cloud with an empty library

settings_error_sync_replace_remote.message: Could not replace this device with the cloud

settings_error_sync_merge.message: Could not merge memories between this device and the cloud

settings_error_sync_restore_backup.message: Could not restore the latest cloud backup

settings_sync_restore_backup_hint.message: Restore the largest pre-overwrite backup if cloud count dropped.

settings_sync_restore_backup_confirm.message: Overwrite the cloud with the largest sync backup, then pull it to this device. Continue?

settings_sync_restore_backup_done.message: Restored $COUNT$ item(s) to the cloud and this device

settings_error_orphan_export.message: Could not export leftover account data

settings_error_orphan_clear.message: Could not clear leftover account data

settings_subscription_sign_in_hint.message: Sign in to check Pro status.

settings_subscription_hybrid_hint.message: Recall quality is the same on Free and Pro. Pro unlocks cloud sync and more LLM quota.

settings_ai_embedding_hint.message: Rebuilds on-device embeddings from memory text.

settings_embedding_backfill_auth_require.message: Sign in to rebuild the semantic index.

settings_ai_quota_sign_in.message: Sign in to use hosted clue understanding and see monthly/daily quota here.

settings_ai_quota_failed.message: Could not load hosted clue quota.

settings_ai_quota_summary.message: Hosted clue understanding · $TIER$: $USED$ / $LIMIT$ this month, $DAILY_USED$ / $DAILY_LIMIT$ today. When exhausted, understanding falls back to rules; recall still works.

pro_required_for_hybrid.message: Cloud sync and a larger hosted LLM quota require Pro; Hybrid recall on this device is available on Free.

settings_orphan_copy.message: $BUCKETS$ leftover account bucket(s), about $ITEMS$ memories. They are hidden from the current account. Export a backup first, then clear.

settings_orphan_clear_confirm.message: Permanently delete $BUCKETS$ leftover account bucket(s) (~$ITEMS$ items) on this device. Data never synced to the cloud cannot be recovered. Your current account and local profile are unchanged.

settings_error_open_shortcuts.message: Could not open the shortcuts page

library_subtitle.message: Bookmarks mirror Chrome folders read-only; excerpts can be browsed, annotated, and deleted. Recall still uses clues.

library_empty_bookmarks_body.message: Bookmarks you add in Chrome show up in this tree; once synced to Yiveno they can be recalled.

library_empty_excerpts_body.message: Select text on a page to save, or use “Save to Yiveno”. These personal traces are what recall works best on.

library_delete_confirm.message: Delete this excerpt? You will not be able to recall it afterward.

detail_subtitle.message: When recalling, read what you saved first, then decide whether to open the original page.

detail_missing_id_body.message: Open this excerpt again from a recall result.

detail_not_found_body.message: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another profile.

detail_deleted_body.message: This excerpt was removed from your library and will not appear in recall.

detail_wrong_type_title.message: This is a bookmark, not an excerpt

detail_wrong_type_body.message: Bookmarks open the original page. Use the link below to go there.

detail_delete_confirm.message: Delete this excerpt? You will not be able to recall it afterward.

detail_note_empty.message: No note yet. Add a short reminder for your future self.

error_memory_not_found.message: This memory was not found. It may have been deleted.

error_memory_delete_bookmark_forbidden.message: Delete bookmarks in Chrome; Yiveno will sync automatically.

error_capture_unsavable_page.message: Can't save a selection from this page. Try on a regular webpage.

error_capture_empty_selection.message: Selection is empty. Select text again, then save.

error_bookmark_ingest_disabled.message: “Write Chrome bookmarks to memory” is off. Turn it on in Settings → Capture.

error_import_status_read_failed.message: Could not read bookmark import status

popup_empty_no_memory_body_importing.message: Your bookmarks are importing. You can also highlight a line to keep—once it’s saved, recall it in your own words.

popup_empty_no_memory_body.message: Highlight a line on a page (or right-click Save selection). Once something’s yours, come back and recall it in your own words.

popup_empty_library_empty_body.message: Nothing in your library matches yet. Save an excerpt or a short note, then come back with any clue in your own words.

popup_capture_first_body.message: Highlight a sentence on any page—or save the demo line on Getting Started—then recall it in your own words.

popup_capture_first_body_importing.message: Your bookmarks are importing. Save one excerpt first—it is the fastest way to see how recall works.

getting_started_hero_body.message: Save one line, then describe it in your own words—no exact title needed.

getting_started_step_capture_body.message: Highlight the demo line below, then tap Save in the floating menu—not the button at the bottom.

getting_started_step_recall_body.message: Open Yiveno and describe what you saved without copying the exact words.

getting_started_demo_line.message: you do not need the exact title—just describe what you remember.

getting_started_demo_save_hint.message: Highlight the line, then tap Save in the menu that appears above your selection.

getting_started_recall_hint.message: Try recalling: “that line about remembering without the exact title”

getting_started_recall_done_body.message: You saved a trace and recalled it in your own words. On any page, highlight text to capture; open Yiveno when something comes back to mind.

popup_no_match_body.message: No saved trace matched that clue. Try a shorter word or a fragment from a note—or save another selection and recall later.
